purpose: Historical audit of vehicle command attempts, parameters, errors, outcomes and activity within the workspace-selected window.
primaryGoal: Review command outcomes for the selected vehicle, find particular commands, and understand activity without losing range, filter or pagination context.

dataSources.name: useCommandReliabilityHistory
dataSources.behavior: Full selected-window retrieval in 1000-entry cursor batches; from/to, before_created_at and before_id are snake_case. Identity includes string-normalized vehicle ID and both bounds. Each request forwards the query AbortSignal; invalid arrays or nonadvancing cursors fail the query rather than publishing partial success. enabled requires vehicle and both bounds; staleTime is STALE_TIMES.QUICK.
dataSources.limits: Handler/repository filtering, status vocabulary, ordering, retention, authorization and cursor behavior were not exercised or independently traced beyond the route/comment. Do not assume response parameter units.

dataSources.name: useSelectedVehicle -> useVehicles
dataSources.behavior: Existing URL vehicle_id, persisted selection and first-fleet-vehicle precedence; known-vehicle reconciliation remains the hook's responsibility. useVehicles passes signal and applies safeArray, with STALE_TIMES.FAST.
dataSources.limits: Fleet loading/failure is not separately exposed to this page by the selected-vehicle result. Runtime selection and fallback were not exercised.

dataSources.name: Workspace and display preferences
dataSources.sourceOwner: useRangeState, useProductPreferences, useTimezone('vehicle'), useNumberFormatting and useOperationalMetrics
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned range registered at workspaceScope.ts:35; range and vehicle controls both enabled by getWorkspaceRouteScope. Product default, shared preference and URL bounds remain canonical; startInstant/endInstantExclusive drive every command-derived summary. Physical command parameters remain raw source values, not invented SI measurements.
dataSources.limits: Preference-hook endpoint graphs are outside this page-specific audit; no settings request or backend capabilities were inferred.

components.name: PageLayout
components.usage: Page title/subtitle, commands navigation, query freshness, full-width min-w-0 container; existing PageContainer adapter, not a new layout engine.

components.name: OperationalBrief + useOperationalMetrics + commandHistoryMetrics
components.usage: Six source-backed metrics, scope, recorded/loading/unavailable/stale labels, freshness and inherited details drawer. Null summary supplies missing measurements rather than fabricated zeroes.

components.name: GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, Caption, Badge
components.usage: Five explicit page panels; typography roles and neutral count badge already reused.

components.name: TabNav, Input, Pagination
components.usage: Pressed status filter buttons, accessible command search, URL-backed pagination with range clamp. Pagination.tsx also retains first/previous/next/last, page slots and validated direct jump.

components.name: EmbeddedChart -> ChartContainer
components.usage: Daily stacked counts; shared loading/error/empty handling, hidden-series controller, chartKey persistence and dataColumns fallback. Export and fullscreen default false in this embedded owner; do not invent existing export/fullscreen actions.

components.name: Timeline
components.usage: Named ordered list, accessible range/count summary, newest-first chronology, caller-supplied title/subtitle/time/icon/color.

components.name: MetricBar
components.usage: Top eight commands and success/failed/other distribution; existing color, fill='solid', label, ariaLabel, sublabel and size APIs are sufficient for restrained adoption.

components.name: useDataState, StaleRefreshWarning, QueryError, EmptyState, Skeleton, FadeIn
components.owner: existing hooks and feedback/motion category owners
components.usage: Historical provenance; fatal-only replacement, retained refresh warnings/retry, section-specific skeletons and empty messages. FadeIn already uses reduced-motion preferences.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Top commands, timeline and status breakdown repeat isLoading -> fatal QueryError -> empty -> content ternaries (467-476, 507-520, 546-554). They share one query, not independent backend sources.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consider the existing SourceContent with state, label, loadingContent, emptyContent and errorRecovery; retain each panel shell, geometry, specialist empty icon and fatal-versus-retained behavior. Do not create another state wrapper or duplicate the global retained warning.

currentStrategy: Filter stack below sm; sm row with full-width search narrowing to sm:w-64 (394-397).
Insights and details stack to one column; xl three-column grids with primary panels spanning two columns (423-425, 497-499).
PageLayout preserves w-full/min-w-0 and container context. ChartContainer owns responsive plot containment and minimum geometry.
Timeline title/time can wrap; subtitle does not have the same wrapping protection. Pagination already has narrow-container target sizing and a direct-jump alternative.

issues.rule: MDC-043: long metadata must remain readable without page overflow
issues.detail: Subtitle is a plain p without break-words/overflow-wrap while title and time explicitly wrap. This page passes raw malformed parameters, parsed key/value text and server error strings (page 600-618); long unbroken tokens present a source-visible overflow risk.
issues.fix: Have the existing Timeline owner add robust subtitle wrapping, preserving every parameter/error character and list semantics. Alternatively a page-owned ReactNode subtitle may use existing Text with wrapping; do not truncate or hide forensic metadata.

accessibility.verifiedBy: Source inspection only; no keyboard, browser, screen-reader or contrast acceptance
positiveEvidence: Search has a localized accessible name (403); deferred filtering exposes role=status/aria-live (410-412).
KPI section has an accessible name (358); timeline receives a localized label and chronology (523-525).

Chart supplies ariaLabel, data and dataColumns (433, 439-444); ChartContainer retains the source-data alternative and distinguishes interactive group from static image semantics (ChartContainer.tsx:444-453, 688-692).
TabNav uses native buttons, aria-pressed and visible focus styling (TabNav.tsx:39-55). Page icons passed for status are explicitly decorative, not accessible outcome names.
FadeIn's reduced-motion path is implemented at FadeIn.tsx:25-33; runtime motion behavior remains unverified.

issues.rule: MDC-025/MDC-040: command outcome requires textual accessible meaning
issues.detail: Timeline items expose command title, params/error subtitle and time, but neither textual status nor a status accessible label. Success/failure distinction is carried by color and aria-hidden CheckCircle/XCircle (303-311). A failed row without error text cannot be distinguished from success by its spoken content.
issues.fix: Compose the existing Timeline title/subtitle ReactNode props with a localized semantic Badge or status Text. Keep the raw status and distinguish other/unknown values; do not invent a new universal status registry.

issues.rule: MDC-040: grouped status filters need a name
issues.detail: TabNav renders role=group with an optional ariaLabel, but this page does not supply it. Individual button names and pressed states exist; the group's purpose is not named.
issues.fix: Pass a localized status-filter ariaLabel through the existing TabNav API. No shared API or catalog edit is authorized by this audit.

issues.rule: MDC-040: stronger mobile target default is 44px
issues.detail: Search explicitly selects Input size=sm; Input.tsx:29 sets min-h-9 (36px). TabNav.tsx:54 uses py-1.5 with text-xs and no min-h-11. Actual composed target geometry and WCAG spacing exceptions were not measured.
issues.fix: Use an existing page className min-h-11 for search on mobile; coordinate a shared TabNav target-height treatment rather than add raw buttons or change global density defaults.

issues.rule: MDC-042: feedback animation respects reduced motion
issues.detail: The deferred-search indicator applies animate-spin directly without a caller-level motion-reduce alternative. Global reduced-motion CSS may suppress it; that global behavior was not inspected or exercised in this scoped audit.
issues.fix: Retain the live filtering status/name while using the existing motion preference or motion-reduce:animate-none. Verify OS reduction and low-bandwidth reduction before claiming compliance.

states.initialLoading: Summary uses OperationalBrief loading; chart uses EmbeddedChart loading; top commands/status rail have 240/200-height skeletons; timeline has four 56-height skeletons. Panel shells stay present.
states.empty: Vehicle prerequisite and selected-window emptiness are distinct in analytics; timeline distinguishes filter miss and no commands. Empty measurements are null through commandHistoryMetrics when commands are unresolved/no vehicle; a successful [] genuinely yields zero counts.
states.fatalError: state.fatalError alone replaces summary/panel bodies with retriable QueryError; query data is not discarded on refresh error.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: StaleRefreshWarning stays above retained content, with state.retry and blocked-refresh copy. The summary uses stale tone/label and last successful dataUpdatedAt rather than claiming live telemetry.
states.offline: Retained paused query is covered by shared DataState/StaleRefreshWarning. Initial paused-without-data handling is not explicitly distinguished in page branches.
states.partial: The command hook accumulates batches locally and publishes only on successful completion; a later batch failure must not be treated as a complete empty or partial result.

issues.rule: MDC-026: unresolved/blocked source is not empty
issues.detail: Panel branches use query.isLoading and commands ?? []; initial paused queries may be pending but not fetching, so isLoading can be false with no fatal error. StaleRefreshWarning.tsx:61 returns null with no retained data. Those branches can therefore show no-commands/range/filter empty messages before a source response. Summary does better by checking commands == null (380).
issues.fix: Map initial pending/paused state and vehicle prerequisites explicitly before empty checks, using existing trust and feedback owners. Show successful [] as empty only after resolution; retain cached commands on paused refresh.

issues.rule: MDC-026: prerequisites are distinct from filter misses
issues.detail: timelineEmptyMsg checks search/status filters before noVehicle, whereas analyticsEmptyMsg checks noVehicle first. A carried q/status with no selected vehicle reports 'No commands match' rather than the unresolved vehicle prerequisite.
issues.fix: Give the selected-vehicle prerequisite priority without clearing URL filters or adding a second vehicle selector. Coordinate fleet-loading versus genuinely empty fleet language through the existing selection owner.

visualIssues.detail: Three page-local hex outcome colors feed chart, timeline and metric bars; top commands cycle up to eight palette colors (284), unrelated to outcome semantics. Default MetricBar fill is a gradient (MetricBar.tsx:46, 97), adding decoration to every ranked/category bar.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing gaugeTone success/danger/neutral and existing approved chart palette. Use MetricBar fill='solid', with a restrained common tone for ranked commands unless identity coloring is demonstrably necessary. Preserve outcome distinction, all series, legends and explicit saved palette choices. CSS-variable colors must not be fed to the default color+'99' gradient construction.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010/MDC-012: decorative accents and borders follow semantic tokens
visualIssues.detail: Daily/top/status headings each have fixed cyan decorative icons (427, 465, 543); search spinner has fixed cyan (413); total separator is fixed border-white/[0.06] (580). These are source-visible theme inconsistencies, not measured contrast failures. No neon text, glow classes or page-level inline styles were found.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing secondary/muted text tokens for decorative icons, existing control/status tokens for the filtering cue and border-default/panel-border for the total separator. Do not alter user theme persistence or globally desaturate explicit chart preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Daily buckets retain full day identity but expose day.slice(5) as MM-DD to axis and fallback table. Multi-year ranges can show identical labels for different days, and the label is not locale-formatted.
visualIssues.fix: Keep the full calendar-day bucket key and timezone calculation; format display labels through existing date helpers with locale and supply full dates in accessible dataColumns. Do not reinterpret calendar keys as UTC timestamps or change server bounds.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-044: existing numeric formatting applies at display boundary
visualIssues.detail: Top-command sublabels use String(count); status-bar sublabels interpolate raw integer counts (562, 569, 577) and the total renders a raw number (583). These bypass the shared numeric formatter although percentages already use fmtPercent.
visualIssues.fix: Use useNumberFormatting's integer formatter for readouts while retaining numeric count/max inputs, raw cached data, percentage precision and sort/rank semantics.

architectureIssues.rule: Inherited missing symbol; mission 34 predictable typed contracts
architectureIssues.detail: History is rendered at lines 501 and 518, but the lucide-react named imports at 43-46 do not include History and no local declaration exists. This is the explicitly inherited missing-History TypeScript problem; current source also indicates an unresolved JSX identifier on the mounted path. It was NOT fixed.
architectureIssues.fix: A later authorized page implementation should resolve History using the existing icon/import policy and verify mounted nonempty and empty branches. This audit does not edit source or claim fresh TypeScript execution.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-025/MDC-045: preserve raw outcome evidence, do not silently reclassify
architectureIssues.detail: Failed KPI is total minus successes, daily activity puts every non-success into failed (266), and timeline uses the failure icon/color for every non-success (303-311). Status breakdown instead counts only status='failed' and separately counts other (290-295). CommandLogEntry.status is string, so source admits values outside the two tabs; actual server vocabulary is unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Record this mismatch for page/integration reconciliation with authoritative backend status semantics before changing calculations. Preserve all raw statuses and counts; if other states exist, make them explicit rather than silently delete/relabel them. Pure modernization must not change business calculations without that evidence.

architectureIssues.detail: Workspace bounds and daily buckets use vehicle timeZone; fallback timeline timestamps force UTC. Last-sent detail also forces UTC (commandSummaryMetrics.tsx:50-51), while summary freshness omits explicit timezone (page 385-386). The UTC fallback has no visible timezone suffix.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve UTC wire timestamps and source instants. Reconcile absolute display timezone with the existing vehicle/user policy through existing formatters; label any deliberately retained UTC display instead of changing date-bound or bucket semantics. Relative-time tz arguments alone are not evidence of a user-visible timezone bug.

priority.first: Inherited unresolved History symbol; initial blocked-data trust and accessible per-command outcome.
priority.next: Reconcile other-status semantics with backend evidence; named/mobile filters and long forensic metadata.
priority.then: Token/solid-fill adoption, locale counts/full dates and absolute timezone clarity.
priority.acceptance: Source audit complete, not implementation or runtime acceptance.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Timeline forensic-metadata wrapping
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Existing subtitle renderer lacks robust unbroken-string wrapping for this production command consumer.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Extend current subtitle presentation only, or allow the page to compose a wrapping Text ReactNode using the already-supported subtitle prop. No new timeline implementation.
requiredSharedChanges.props: Existing TimelineItemData.subtitle?: ReactNode, title, time, color, items, label and chronology remain unchanged; no new public prop is necessary.
requiredSharedChanges.variants: Existing chronological ordered list; no competing mobile truncation variant.
dependsOn: Shared owner acceptance and responsive regression evidence
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Only this consumer was inspected. This is a bounded existing-owner presentation gap, not proof authorizing a new multi-consumer component.

requiredSharedChanges.name: TabNav mobile target treatment
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Status buttons have compact padding but no explicit mobile 44px minimum. Parent/global target policy should remain shared rather than be recreated by the page.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Review measured size/spacing; if required, apply mobile min-height within the current TabNav owner while preserving compact desktop density. The page can already pass a localized group ariaLabel.
requiredSharedChanges.props: Existing tabs[{key,label,icon}], active, onChange(key), ariaLabel and className retained; no speculative API or new control registry.
requiredSharedChanges.variants: Current selected/unselected segmented status filter; preserve horizontal overflow and button semantics.
dependsOn: Actual composed target measurements or documented spacing exception
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Do not alter global density defaults or assume other consumers were audited.

competingImplementations.detail: Page-local outcome hex constants overlap the existing gaugeTone owner at lib\tokens.ts:340-350. Existing MetricBar can already accept solid fills; no additional progress renderer is needed.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse existing semantic fills and fill='solid'; keep domain outcome classification in the feature, not shared presentation.

competingImplementations.detail: Repeated local loading/error/empty branches overlap the existing SourceContent API. Current behavior is not inherently broken; any adoption must retain panel-specific geometry and messages.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse or locally compose the existing SourceContent instead of creating another generic query-state component.

preservation.sourceHashBasis: Current root file bytes, captured with Get-FileHash; not historical Git content.
preservation.lineCountNotes: commandSummaryMetrics.tsx is a shared feature adapter also containing reliability metrics; its full 108 lines are not claimed as exclusive page-owned UI.
actions: Navigate to /commands through the existing Link (344-350).
All/Success/Failed filters update status and reset page in one atomic URL write (183-185).
Search raw command identifiers and translated command labels through deferred q, resetting page atomically (187-202, 210-215).
Read/display filter-pending live status without blocking typing (408-415).
Paginate 25 matching commands with URL-backed page and clamp (219-224, 527-533); preserve shared first/previous/next/last, numbered and validated direct-jump controls.
Retry fatal query failures in every source-backed body and retry retained refresh failures through StaleRefreshWarning.
Toggle daily success/failed series using the existing chart legend and system-command-daily-activity persistence key.
Retain the inherited OperationalBrief details drawer and source/scope/freshness metadata.
Keep shell-owned vehicle and View settings controls; do not add page-owned replacements.
No command-send mutation, page-level table export, fullscreen or parameter editing exists here; do not invent them as preservation claims.
data: Preserve CommandLogEntry id, vehicle_id, command, params, status, error and created_at fields as source evidence; no SI conversion is inferred for opaque params.
Retain complete range retrieval with cursor batches, validation, AbortSignal, query keys, enablement and stale/retry policy.
Summary, daily activity, top eight rankings and status breakdown use the full workspace-selected feed, not status/search-filtered timeline rows.
Total24h is the last 24 hours within the selected feed; most-used ranking and last command assume existing returned ordering/tie behavior. Do not silently change calculations.
Keep raw statuses and the existing other category while resolving the documented conflicting failure classification with integration evidence.
Bucket calendar days using vehicle timezone and preserve [startInstant,endInstantExclusive) query semantics, URL bounds, rolling presets, shared preferences and DST behavior.
Maintain filtered timeline source order, 25-row slices, URL clamp, atomic status/q/page writes and search localization fallback.
Retain JSON parameter rendering, raw parse-failure fallback, localized error prefix, timestamp fallback and original unmodified source strings.
Unknown/unresolved metrics remain missing; a successful empty result remains a real zero-count result. Stale or offline refresh does not discard retained payload.
Keep percentage precision, integer raw inputs, localized command labels, named list/chart alternatives, and all current metadata rather than hiding secondary detail on mobile.
